verdict.rationale: Mastra's own observability system is documented to give visibility into every agent run, tool call, and model interaction. Its Studio UI (localhost:4111 or hosted) is documented for inspecting runs and traces, which together cover the story's core. missing for 10: in-depth docs on trace/span detail (e.g., per-call inputs/outputs, token usage), independent or hands-on corroboration of the tracing UI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace every LLM call and tool invocation of an agent run in an observability UI

citations.quote: Mastra's observability system gives you visibility into every agent run, workflow step, tool call, and model interaction.
Studio: A hosted visual environment for testing agents and running workflows, plus inspecting traces
Open Studio at [`http://localhost:4111`](http://localhost:4111) to test your agent and inspect its runs.
